register.labelZh: PHONE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: phone in 適合用來通知工作地點或其他機構,說明自己會缺席或遲到。；當記者或其他工作人員無法上網時,可以使用 phone something in,以電話傳回報道、賽果或最新消息。；phone round 可以表示逐一致電多個人或地方,以比較價格、查詢空位或收集資料。；phone something through 適合用來透過電話直接傳達訂單、地址或其他重要資料。
register.summaryEn: Phone in is useful when you need to tell your workplace or another organisation that you will be absent or late. Reporters and other workers can phone a story, result or update in when they cannot send it online. Phone round helps you describe calling several people or places to compare prices, check availability or collect information. Phone something through is useful for sending an order, address or other important information directly by telephone.
contextsZh: 有效率地聯絡多個地方
contextsEn: Report an absence or delay clearly
